name: backend
description: WebSocket broadcast relay, plus one small addition as of Phase 2: the timer-expiry sweep (Section 5.3 'opens_at, closes_at — the authoritative timer'). It still holds zero bidding/trading/scoring RULES — every mutation it triggers still goes through packages/game-engine's closeLot, so the rules stay single-sourced (Section 3.1 #1) — but it is the one long-running process able to poll 'has this lot's timer expired' on an interval, which a serverless Next.js API route cannot do.
